newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti ready to use Autostrade network.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti ready to use Autostrade network.

text.p: Italian information and technology group Olivetti said its Infostrada venture with U.S. Bell Atlantic is ready to start using the telecoms network of Italian motorway operator Autostrade.

The fixed-line telecoms venture Infostrada signed a preliminary accord in June 1996 allowing it to use the telecom transmission circuits of the Autostrade group. Infostrada was formed in 1995 and is 67 percent owned by Olivetti and 33 percent by Bell Atlantic.

Olivetti said in a statement that Infostrada had completed its tests on 1,500 km of fibre optic cable of the Autostrade network under hire to Infostrada and in a very short time it would start using the telecoms network. Autostrade's total fibre optic cable network is around 3,000 km.
